column2: The larva of a beetle lives underground, feeding on roots until it is ready to change.
column3: 甲蟲的幼蟲生活在地下，吃著根部，直到準備好變態。
column5: larva 拉丁文有「面具」之意，幼蟲還戴著面具，不是成蟲的樣子

column2: Inside the pupa, the caterpillar's body is completely rebuilt into its adult form.
column3: 在蛹裡面，毛毛蟲的身體被完全重建成成蟲的形態。
column5: pupa 拉丁文是「娃娃」，包得像小娃娃一動也不動

column2: The silkworm spins a cocoon of fine thread and waits inside until it emerges as a moth.
column3: 蠶用細絲吐出一個繭，在裡面等待，直到變成蛾破繭而出。
column5: cocoon 中間兩個 oo 像蟲寶寶睜大的眼睛，躲在繭裡看外面

column2: The green chrysalis hung beneath the leaf until the monarch butterfly finally broke free.
column3: 綠色的蝶蛹掛在葉子底下，直到帝王斑蝶終於破蛹而出。
column5: chrys 是金色，像 chrysanthemum 菊花，有些蝶蛹閃著金光

column2: Juvenile salmon spend months in the river before swimming out to the ocean.
column3: 幼年的鮭魚在游向大海前，會在河裡度過好幾個月。
column5: juven 是年輕，像 rejuvenate 回春，還年輕的

column2: Feral cats living in the alley hunt rats and avoid all contact with people.
column3: 住在小巷裡的野化貓會獵捕老鼠，並避免和人接觸。
column5: feral 諧音「非熱」，被丟棄後對人不再熱情，回到野外

column2: Dogs were domesticated thousands of years ago, when wolves began following hunters to eat their scraps.
column3: 狗在數千年前被馴化，當時狼開始跟著獵人吃他們剩下的食物。
column5: dom 家，像 domestic 家庭的，被帶回家養的

column2: Through selective breeding, farmers produced sweeter corn by planting only the best kernels each year.
column3: 透過選育，農民每年只種最好的玉米粒，培育出更甜的玉米。
column5: selective 挑選 + breeding 繁殖，人挑最好的來生下一代

column2: Under natural selection, moths with darker wings survived on soot-covered trees because birds could not see them.
column3: 在天擇之下，翅膀較深色的蛾能在被煤煙覆蓋的樹上存活，因為鳥看不到牠們。
column4: evolve by natural selection (透過天擇演化)
column5: 大自然當裁判，不合適的被淘汰，合適的留下來
column7: nat - u - ral se - lec - tion

column2: Darwin's idea of survival of the fittest means animals best matched to their environment leave the most offspring.
column3: 達爾文的適者生存概念是指，最適應環境的動物會留下最多的後代。
column4: survival of the fittest (適者生存)
column5: fittest 是最合身，衣服最合身的才能活下來
column7: sur - viv - al of the fit - test

column2: In a tiny island population, genetic drift can make a rare trait common purely by chance.
column3: 在小島的小族群中，遺傳漂變能純粹靠機率讓罕見性狀變得普遍。
column4: effects of genetic drift (遺傳漂變的效果)
column5: drift 是漂流，基因像小船隨機漂，沒有人在划槳

column2: Bringing in a few outside animals enlarged the gene pool of the isolated wolf population.
column3: 引進幾隻外來動物，擴大了這群孤立狼群的基因庫。
column4: shared gene pool (共有的基因庫)
column5: pool 是游泳池，全族群的基因都泡在同一個池子裡

column2: The giant panda was once endangered, with only a few hundred left in the wild.
column3: 大貓熊曾經瀕臨絕種，野外只剩下幾百隻。
column5: en 使成為 + danger 危險 + ed，被推進危險裡的

column2: Newly hatched sea turtles are vulnerable to birds as they crawl across the open beach.
column3: 剛孵化的海龜爬過空曠的海灘時，很容易遭到鳥類攻擊。
column5: vuln 是傷口，身上有傷口，更容易再受傷

column2: Poaching has pushed the rhino to the brink, since hunters sell its horn on the black market.
column3: 盜獵把犀牛逼到了滅絕邊緣，因為獵人把牠的角賣到黑市。
column5: poach 是偷偷闖進別人的地盤抓動物，像小偷偷蛋

column2: Wildlife conservation groups work with villagers to protect elephants and their forest homes.
column3: 野生動物保育團體與村民合作，保護大象和牠們的森林家園。
column5: con 一起 + serve 保存，大家一起把它保存好

column2: The marsh was declared a bird sanctuary, so hunting there is now forbidden.
column3: 這片沼澤被宣布為鳥類保護區，所以現在禁止在那裡狩獵。
column5: sanct 是神聖，像 saint 聖人，神聖而不可侵犯的安全地

column2: The meadow's carrying capacity is about fifty deer; beyond that number, they will run short of food.
column3: 這片草地的承載量約為五十頭鹿，超過這個數量，牠們就會缺乏食物。
column5: carry 承載 + capacity 容量，環境這輛卡車最多能載多少
column7: car - ry - ing ca - pac - i - ty

column2: A hawk sits at a higher trophic level than a mouse because it eats animals that eat plants.
column3: 老鷹的營養階層比老鼠高，因為牠吃的是吃植物的動物。
column4: higher trophic level (較高營養階層)
column5: troph 是營養，像一層層吃東西的階梯

column2: Remove one species and the whole food web, with its tangled feeding links, can shift.
column3: 拿走一個物種，整張交錯著取食關係的食物網就可能改變。
column5: web 是蜘蛛網，誰吃誰連成一張網而不是一條線

column2: Sea otters are a keystone species: by eating urchins, they keep kelp forests from disappearing.
column3: 海獺是關鍵物種：牠們吃海膽，讓海帶森林不致消失。
column5: keystone 是拱門頂端的楔石，一抽掉整座拱門就垮

column2: Zebra mussels, an invasive species, clog pipes and crowd out native shellfish across the Great Lakes.
column3: 斑馬貽貝是入侵物種，堵塞管線，並排擠五大湖各地的原生貝類。
column4: control invasive species (控制入侵物種)
column5: invade 入侵 + ive，闖進別人家搶地盤的物種

column2: Planting native species helps local birds, because they already depend on those plants for food.
column3: 種植原生物種對本地鳥類有益，因為牠們本來就靠這些植物當食物。
column4: native species thrive (原生物種繁盛)
column5: native 是本地人，從小就在這裡長大的物種

column2: Lemurs are endemic to Madagascar, meaning they live wild nowhere else in the world.
column3: 狐猴是馬達加斯加特有的，意思是世界上其他地方都沒有野生的牠們。
column5: en 在裡面 + dem 地方人民，只在這個地方才有

column2: Planting wheat across one vast monoculture lets a single disease wipe out the entire harvest.
column3: 把小麥種滿一大片單一栽培的田，一種病害就可能毀掉整季收成。
column5: mono 單一 + culture 栽培，一整片只種一種

column2: In a polyculture, farmers grow beans, corn, and squash together so each crop helps the others.
column3: 在多元間作中，農民把豆、玉米和南瓜種在一起，讓每種作物互相幫助。
column5: poly 多 + culture 栽培，一塊田種很多種

column2: Spraying a pesticide on the cabbages removed the caterpillars but also harmed nearby bees.
column3: 在高麗菜上噴殺蟲劑除掉了毛毛蟲，卻也傷害了附近的蜜蜂。
column5: pest 害蟲 + cide 殺死，專門對付害蟲的藥

column2: Farmers use herbicide to clear weeds from the field before planting soybeans.
column3: 農民在種大豆前，用除草劑清除田裡的雜草。
column5: herb 草 + cide 殺除，專門除草的藥

column2: Adding fertilizer to poor soil gives plants the nitrogen they need to grow tall.
column3: 在貧瘠的土壤中加肥料，能提供植物長高所需的氮。
column5: fertile 肥沃 + izer 使成為，讓土地變肥沃的東西

column2: Fertilizer runoff caused eutrophication in the lake, and the water slowly turned murky green.
column3: 肥料流失造成湖泊優養化，湖水慢慢變成混濁的綠色。
column5: eu 好 + troph 營養，營養太好了，反而出事

column2: A thick algal bloom spread across the bay in summer and turned the water bright green.
column3: 夏天一大片藻華在海灣擴散，把海水染成鮮綠色。
column5: bloom 是花開，藻像花一樣突然大量綻放

column2: Warmer seas triggered coral bleaching, leaving the once-colorful reef a pale, ghostly white.
column3: 海水變暖引發珊瑚白化，讓曾經繽紛的珊瑚礁變成蒼白的白色。
column4: mass coral bleaching (大規模珊瑚白化)
column5: bleach 是漂白水，珊瑚被漂白成了雪白

column2: Ocean acidification occurs when seawater absorbs extra carbon dioxide, making it harder for shellfish to build shells.
column3: 海洋酸化發生在海水吸收過多二氧化碳時，使貝類更難形成外殼。
column4: ocean acidification threatens reefs (海洋酸化威脅珊瑚礁)
column5: acid 酸 + ify 變成，海水一點一點變酸
column7: o - cean a - cid - i - fi - ca - tion

column2: Through conditioning, the dog learned to drool whenever it heard the sound of its food bowl.
column3: 透過制約，那隻狗學會了每次聽到食盆的聲音就流口水。
column5: condition 條件，在某個條件下就做出固定反應

column2: Pavlov demonstrated classical conditioning when dogs began salivating at a bell that always came before food.
column3: 巴夫洛夫示範了古典制約：狗開始對總在食物之前響起的鈴聲流口水。
column4: classical conditioning experiment (古典制約實驗)
column5: 巴夫洛夫的鈴聲加口水：鈴一響，就流口水
column7: clas - si - cal con - di - tion - ing

column2: Operant conditioning explains why a rat presses a lever more often when each press delivers a food pellet.
column3: 操作制約說明了為什麼老鼠在每按一次拉桿就得到一顆食物時，會更常按拉桿。
column5: operate 操作，動物自己動手操作，結果決定下次還做不做
column7: op - er - ant con - di - tion - ing

column2: Praise from the teacher served as reinforcement, encouraging the shy student to speak up again.
column3: 老師的稱讚成了強化，鼓勵害羞的學生再次發言。
column5: re 再 + inforce 加強，獎勵讓行為再被加強一次

column2: Giving a puppy a treat each time it sits is positive reinforcement that makes sitting more likely.
column3: 小狗每次坐下就給牠點心，是讓坐下更常發生的正向強化。
column4: use positive reinforcement (使用正向強化)
column5: positive 像加號 +，加上好東西讓行為增加
column7: pos - i - tive re - in - force - ment

column2: Fastening the seat belt stops the annoying alarm, so the beeping is a case of negative reinforcement.
column3: 繫上安全帶就會停止惱人的警報聲，所以那個嗶嗶聲屬於負向強化。
column4: negative reinforcement works (負向強化有效)
column5: negative 像減號 −，拿走討厭的東西，行為反而增加，不是處罰
column7: neg - a - tive re - in - force - ment

column2: Studies of infant cognition show that babies notice patterns long before they can speak.
column3: 嬰兒認知的研究顯示，寶寶在會說話之前很久就能察覺規律。
column5: co + gnit 知道，像 recognize 認出，腦中理解的過程
